name: hn-copy-links
description: Copy a Hacker News article link and its comment link with one click

scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:chrome && npm run deploy:firefox
scripts.store-assets: npm run deploy:chrome && node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs && node scripts/make-amo-metadata.cjs
scripts.submit:firefox: npm run deploy:firefox && web-ext sign --channel listed --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir outputs --amo-metadata store-assets/amo-metadata.json
